रोग रोग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. रुज्), ‘breaking
up of strength,’ infirmity, weakness, sickness, disease,
malady, (क्षुद्-रोग, disease from hunger; क्षे-
त्रिय-रोग, an incurable disease, see क्षेत्रिय);
Disease regarded as an evil genius or demon; Costus
Speciosus or Arabicus.
—रोग-ग्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
seized with sickness, sick, diseased.
—रोग-घ्न,
अस्, ई, अम्, removing sickness, curative, remedial,
medicinal; (अम्), n. medicine.
—रोग-ज्ञान, अम्,
n. knowledge of diseases.
—रोग-द, अस्, आ, अम्,
giving or causing sickness.
—रोग-नाशन, अस्, ई,
अम्, Ved. destroying sickness, removing disease.
—रोग-निग्रहण, अम्, n. suppression of disease.
—रोग-प्रद, अस्, आ, अम्, causing disease.
—रोग-
भय, अम्, n. fear of disease.
—रोग-भाज्, क्, क्, क्,
possessing sickness, one who suffers from disease, ill,
sick.
—रोग-भू, ऊस्, f. the place or seat of sickness,
the body.
—रोग-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from
sickness, recovered from illness.
—रोग-मुरारि
(˚र-अरि), इस्, m., N. of a work on medicine.
—रोग-
राज, अस्, m. ‘king of sicknesses,’ consumption.
—रोग-लक्षण, अम्, n. the sign or symptoms
of a disease.
—रोग-शान्तक, अस्, m. a curer of
disease, a physician.
—रोग-शान्ति, इस्, f. cure or
alleviation of disease.
—रोग-शिला, f. realgar, red
arsenic.
—रोग-शिल्पिन्, ई, m. a species of plant (com-
monly called Śaralu), Cassia Fistula.
—रोग-श्रेष्-
ठ, अस्, m. ‘the chief of sicknesses,’ fever.
—रोग-
ह, अम्, n. ‘destroying disease,’ a drug, medicament.
—रोग-हन्, हा, m. ‘remover of disease,’ a phy-
sician.
—रोग-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, taking away disease,
remedial, curative, medicinal; (अम्), n. medicine.
—रोग-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, taking away disease, curing,
curative; (ई), m. a physician.
—रोग-हृत्, त्, त्, त्,
curing disease; (त्), m. a physician.
—रोगान्तक
(˚ग-अन्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, ‘disease-destroying,’ curative,
medicinal; (अस्), m. a physician.
—रोगान्वित (˚ग-
अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, possessed of sickness, sick, diseased.
—रोगायतन (˚ग-आय्˚), अम्, n. the abode of
disease, seat of malady, the body.
—रोगार्त (˚ग-
आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, suffering from sickness or disease,
afflicted with any disease.
—रोगोन्मादित (˚ग-
उन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, maddened with disease, mad (said
of a dog).
—रोगोपशम (˚ग-उप्˚), अस्, m. cure or
alleviation of disease.
—रोगोल्बण-ता (˚ग-उल्˚), f.,
Ved. the spreading or raging of diseases.

रोगित, अस्, आ, अम्, diseased, suffering from sick-
ness; mad (said of a dog).

रोगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, sick, sickly, diseased, ill, (मन्द-
रोगिन्, seldom ill.)
—रोगि-तरु, उस्, m. ‘tree of
the sick, ‘epithet of the Aśoka tree.
—रोगि-ता, f.
sickness, illness, a diseased state.
—रोगि-वल्लभ,
अम्, n. ‘friend of the sick,’ medicine, a drug.

रोगिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of रोगिन्), one who
is always sickly or ill.

रोग्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. रोग), related to or con-
nected with disease, producing sickness, unwhole-
some, unhealthy; (रोग्य may also be a fut. part.
pass. fr. rt. 1. रुज्, q. v.)
